SINGLE_BLOCK_TOGETHER.rule: All specified block members must occupy consecutive positions.

SINGLE_BLOCK_COMPLEMENT.rule: Exclude arrangements in which every specified member forms one consecutive block.

MULTIPLE_BLOCKS.rule: Each specified disjoint group must form its own consecutive block.

BLOCK_WITH_EXTERNAL_PAIR_APART.rule: One specified group forms a block while a disjoint specified pair must not be adjacent.

BLOCK_INVERSE.rule: Search the stated finite domain and require exactly one parameter matching the target.
